purpose: Define a reproducible PRE-only baseline that can produce rider win weights for future races without inventing probabilities or using market/result/payout information.
scope: cheap real baseline S0 only; not production and not model promotion
line_feature_policy: NO_LINE in S0. Line-aware information belongs to separate C1 baseline and must fail closed when point-in-time line snapshot is unavailable.
missingness_policy: Do not impute from post-race sources. Missing PRE fields must be represented explicitly and the race may be scored only under a prespecified missingness transform learned from training data.

training_design.target: winner indicator from separately authorized development outcomes
training_design.sample_membership: must be frozen before outcome access
training_design.validation: forward chronological split under Strict Temporal Backtester

model_form_candidates.name: S0_LOGIT_SOFTMAX
model_form_candidates.description: standardize numeric PRE features using training-only statistics; one-hot categorical class/style; fit multinomial/conditional-logit style rider utilities; convert per-race utilities with softmax to winner probabilities

model_form_candidates.name: S0_SCORE_ONLY_SOFTMAX
model_form_candidates.description: competition_score-only softmax baseline with one training-fitted scale parameter; retained as the cheapest sanity baseline

selection_rule: Compare S0_SCORE_ONLY_SOFTMAX and S0_LOGIT_SOFTMAX on forward development evaluation using log loss, Brier, calibration, ranking, sample size and temporal stability. Do not choose by ROI or hit rate.

probability_contract.winner_probabilities: strictly positive and sum to 1 within race
probability_contract.ordered_top3: derive using the already-audited Plackett-Luce transformation only after winner probabilities pass invariants
probability_contract.shadow_band: must not be created until probability model coefficients and any safety margin rule are locked before the target race

current_20260902_rule: No numeric win probabilities, fair odds, expected value, or ticket thresholds may be claimed for 2026-09-02 races unless a coefficient-bearing model has first been trained and locked without those races' outcomes.
example_numbers_policy: Any previously discussed ticket combinations or odds numbers were illustrative only and must never seed coefficients, ticket candidates, thresholds, priors, or evaluation expectations.
